arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made with a prepaid debit card, whatever the amount, merchant or transaction type.
assumptions: Took 'prepaid debit card' to mean card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' only. Regular 'Debit' cards are not included.
